name: Developer
description: Cybersecurity-grade dark portfolio for engineers — deep-navy canvas, sky-blue glow, an interactive molecular-network hero, case-file projects, and a live terminal panel.
designNotes: The Developer template reads like a security operator's workstation: a deep-navy field lit by a sky-blue molecular network that reacts to the cursor, Inter for confident headings and prose with JetBrains Mono reserved for the terminal panel. Projects are presented as numbered 'case files' — a featured discovery up top, then a status-tagged grid — which frames engineering work as investigation rather than a list. Color is data-driven: skill, project, and credential accents cycle through the palette (sky, cyan, success-green, cerulean, purple, silver) so any number of items stays visually varied without per-item configuration. The contact terminal renders whoami / credentials / nmap from real portfolio data and is force-locked LTR so it stays readable in Arabic RTL layouts. All scroll-reveal content has a no-GSAP fallback so a blocked CDN never leaves the page blank.
